build_fastgen_generator: build a FastGen generator with GenArgs, model, tokenizer, and CUDA graph decoding for batched text generation
create_genargs_config: create a GenArgs dataclass to configure sampling temperature, top_p, max_batch, cache_block, and prefill bounds
run_generate_loop: run the FastGen generate method with a queue of api.Packet objects to yield generated text packets
create_lane_from_packet: create a Lane from an api.Packet using Lane.from_pkt with max_seq and max_gen parameters
request_profiling_trace: request a profiling trace on the FastGen generator by calling request_profile or sending SIGUSR2 signal
